name: Connection — dynamic deployment listing
summary: Connections that declare a `modelDiscovery` endpoint and rely on runtime GET /models calls to enumerate deployments are not honored — only the static `models[]` array works today.
description: AI Gateway connections can list deployments statically in `models[]` or dynamically through a `modelDiscovery` endpoint that Foundry calls while validating `{connection}/{deployment}`. This matters when users want APIM or ModelGateway to discover upstream model deployments without editing connection metadata for every model.
notes:
Not yet probed as a standalone connection-listing/UI behavior with a captured server response. Docs: https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/foundry/agents/how-to/ai-gateway.

See `routing-static-vs-dynamic-discovery` and `prompt-agents-dynamic` for the concrete agent-path proof that dynamic-discovery routing works; this separate connection-listing status should be reconciled against that evidence.
